notes.title: Update 0.2.0
notes.notes:
What’s New:

New Levels:

Prologue — "Prologue": Dive into the very beginning of the story where the knights first encounter the ancient darkness.
"City of Dead Silence": Explore a mysterious city where every sound could be your last. Prepare for tough battles and unexpected encounters with shadowy enemies.
Fixes and Improvements:

Performance optimization for smoother gameplay.
Localization fixes (English): Improved text and interface display in English.

notes.title: Ashen Knights 0.1.3 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Greetings, Noble Knights!

We are pleased to present you with a new patch for Ashen Knights: Foreshadow. In this update, we have focused on addressing various issues and making some changes to enhance the gaming experience. Let's delve into the details:

Changes:
- Aiming with Priamos's arrows now functions with the right stick in both gamepad control variants
- Adjusted Priamos's turns in combat stance and aiming with arrow skill relative to camera rotation
- When the note is opened, any key on the keyboard or the middle mouse button can now close it

Fixes:
- Fixed collision of brick wall in the "Deliverance" chapter
- Fixed collision issue with abyssal bubbles on the boss arena in the "Deliverance" chapter
- Fixed collision for the cage in the "Knighthood" chapter
- Fixed softlock preventing entry into the house with the dog in the "Village" location within the "Knighthood" chapter
- Fixed sound issue with door mechanisms that did not stop
- Fixed sound retrigger issue when enemies step on fire
- Fixed ambient playback error on "Knighthood" and "The Myst Forest" chapters
- Balanced SFX volume

notes.title: Ashen Knights 0.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Greetings Knights!

Today's update brings a series of fixes aimed at improving the gaming experience. We are constantly working on fixing various bugs to provide you with the best interaction with the game. Additionally, we are pleased to introduce a new map for "The Myst Forest" chapter.

Our team is always open to your suggestions and feedback. Your input helps us make the game better, so please don't hesitate to share your thoughts and ideas. We are always striving to ensure that our game is as satisfying as possible for our players.

Additions:
- Added a map for "The Myst Forest" chapter

Fixes:
- Fixed stun lock from constant damage in swamp locations
- Disabled the ability to roll during flight
- Shield can no longer parry spears from traps
- Fixed Softlock on the "Knighthood" level
- Fixed a bug with the appearance of the "rain" weather effect outside the village boundaries
- Fixed cases where fire damage was not occurring in the "Deliverance" chapter
- Minor collision bug fixes in the chapters "Delivцerance" and "Knighthood"

notes.title: Ashen Knights Foreshadow. Early Access Release.
notes.notes:
We have come a long way with the efforts of our developers, and after many years, Ashen Knights Foreshadow has finally been released in early access. We will continue to put in a lot of work, gathering your feedback and comments to release an excellent game in version 1.0.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2008200/Ashen_Knights_Foreshadow/?beta=0

For the full version, we plan to include:
6 chapters of the story campaign
2 boss battles
1 mini-boss battle

Currently available in early access:
3 chapters of the story campaign
4 boss battles


Join our Discord server for updates and more information!
